exposure: emergency cerclage in preterm twin pregnancies
emergency cerclage in preterm singleton pregnancies
outcome: preterm delivery at 32 weeks gestational age
preterm delivery at 28 weeks gestational age
cohort: Preterm infants born to women who underwent emergency cerclage from 2008 to 2014, including 32 twins and 121 singletons.
finding: Emergency cerclage in twin pregnancies resulted in a higher mortality rate for preterm babies compared to emergency cerclage in singleton pregnancies.
followup_time: during hospitalization and up to 7 days after birth
